up: List all distinct molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1944551'. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (pref_name), the maximum development phase (max_phase), the molecule type (molecule_type), and the canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). Return the results sorted by the molecule ChEMBL ID in ascending order. Use the docs table to identify the document by its chembl_id, then join to compound_records on doc_id to get the molecules, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and finally to compound_structures on molregno. Ensure that each molecule is listed only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1944551' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC;
